answer: Guide and assistance dogs travel free for disabled passengers on flights within the EU and on flights from EU countries to destinations outside the EU. You must tell Wizz Air when you book and send the required documents at least 48 hours before departure.
note: The free-carriage rule covers within-EU and EU-to-outside flights only. This route is outside-to-EU, which the chunks don't cover.
